verdict.rationale: The only event-triggered automation in the evidence is narrow and built in. Autobilling automatically tops up the account from a saved card when the balance runs low [vast-ai-docs-8, vast-ai-docs-25]. Serverless offers automatic benchmark-driven scaling [vast-ai-docs-46]. Neither is a general facility for user-defined rules or triggers; anything broader would have to be scripted externally via the CLI/API. Missing for 10: user-definable rules or triggers on platform events (e.g. instance state changes, outbid or interruption), webhooks or event notifications, configurable conditions and actions, and documentation or hands-on corroboration of any rules engine.
